messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate on /v1/generate (us-east-1). 5xx spike > 15m threshold. INC-2026. Root alert at 1919999999

alex: Oncall pickup. I'll start triage.

samira: I'll join. quick check — is this traffic spike or infra OOM?

chris: Looks like a traffic spike causing worker OOMs and downstream 502s. Seen among a few high-volume tenants. Logs: `runtime: failed to allocate kvcache` repeated.

maria: Customer impact visible: top 12 tenants show elevated error rates, several teams reporting streaming disconnects. CS pinged.

alex: Runbook suggests mitigation ladder: 1) client-side guidance 2) per-key rate caps 3) disable heavy features 4) infra scaling if needed. Start with non-invasive steps.

samira: I'll apply a conservative quota patch on the control plane: set per-key QPS cap to 12 for all active projects for 60 minutes, then reassess. No infra roll required. Executing now: `POST /admin/quotas/patch {"selector":"active","qps":12,"duration_min":60}`

ops-bot: Job queued: quota-patch-1919999999 -> started

ops-bot: Job success: quota-patch-1919999999 -> applied to 173 projects (job id qpatch-1919999999) :white_check_mark:

alex: Parallel: we should publish immediate SDK guidance so clients can back off politely. Small SDK patch + advisory to reduce retries and enable backoff/jitter. Samira, can you coordinate release?

samira: On it. Draft guidance below. Will push release to releases channel and CDN.

samira: SDK advisory (send as one-line snippet to engineers/customers):
```
// temporary mitigation: reduce retries + enable expo backoff + idempotency
const client = new Redwood({
  retry: {
    maxRetries: 3,            // lowered from 5
    baseDelayMs: 150,         // start at 150ms
    maxDelayMs: 5000,         // cap delay
    jitter: true              // randomized backoff
  },
  stream: false              // disable streaming to avoid long-lived connections
});
// include idempotency for mutating calls
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = uuidv4();
```

chris: Key points to call out in the advisory: require idempotency-key for POSTs that change KV, recommend exponential backoff with full-jitter, and set default maxRetries to 3. Also call out that streaming may be temporarily disabled.

maria: I'll run the tenant list and apply soft per-tenant caps for top 10 noisy tenants. Query running... applying caps now.

ops-bot: Tenant caps job success: tenant-cap-1919999999 -> applied to 10 tenants.

samira: Released SDK patch to CDN as v1.2.3-temp1 and posted advisory to #releases and #status-updates. Ops: please watch for adoption metrics.

ops-bot: Release job success: sdk-release-1919999999 -> v1.2.3-temp1 deployed :rocket:

alex: Early signal: after quota patch + advisory, error-rate dropped from ~4.6% -> ~1.0% in 12m. Latency stable. Good. Keep monitoring for at least 30m.

chris: CS will email top 10 customers with suggested client-side changes and offer help to perform SDK upgrade. @support please coordinate.

support: Acknowledged. Drafting customer note with recommended snippets and impact summary.

alex: Next steps: 1) keep quotas in place for 60m, 2) monitor error rate and token burn, 3) rollback quota patch gradually if stable, 4) prepare infra scaling if error rate remains >1.5%. Re-eval at +1h.

samira: Adding a temporary metric alert: if 5xx > 1.5% for 15m post-mitigation -> page infra.

maria: Noted. I'll maintain the tenant caps and be ready to adjust.

chris: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open. Tagging product for postmortem and longer-term SDK defaults discussion.

product: We'll include this in the next retro and propose a default SDK backoff profile and optional streaming throttle flag.

alex: Closing loop when rotated back. :white_check_mark:
